description: 豊田市上下水道局 配水水量データ(2024/3/31更新) [sewerage and wastewater] is a dataset listed in BODIK Open Data Catalogue Service (data.bodik.jp), Japanese local governments, an open data portal, published or maintained by 豊田市. 【2023年度ほか】豊田市上下水道局の監視区域別の月毎配水流量データです。 （単位：㎥）. Coverage: 豊田市. The portal files it under the publisher 豊田市. Its tags are 上下水道, 水道データ. It offers 2 resource(s) in csv, xlsx. The portal shows 2025-03-31 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Japanese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support wastewater and sewer network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-jp-bodik-portal.
